answer: Sybil resistance via stake-weighted reputation slot: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation tier, and new identities start at zero with a mandatory probation voyage of verified tasks before earning voting weight. Forged identities multiply cost linearly, so a thousand fake agents require a thousand bonds, making attacks economically irrational. Reputation compounds like a lotus unfolding only after sustained honest work, while every new node is screened as sharply as yarrow's feathery leaves divide, ensuring inexpensive throwaway accounts never gain influence.
